Easywurld — 30 Day Social Plan

11 core posts a day, restructured for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn

Every post is ready to publish. Hook, beats, voiceover, slide copy, caption, hashtags and visual direction are all written. No placeholders, nothing to decide on the day.
Plan startsMonday 19 October 2026 (change it in the app if you want a different month)
EndsTuesday 17 November 2026
Daily volume11 core posts → 11 TikTok + 11 Instagram + 11 Facebook + 4 LinkedIn (+1 optional) = 37 posts a day
Month total1,140 posts (1,110 scheduled + 30 optional)
TimesAfrica/Lagos (WAT, UTC+1). Every post block carries its own time.
Phone toolEASYWURLD_POST_COMMANDER.html — one file, works offline, copy button on every block, tick marks that save on the phone.
Spreadsheetcontent_calendar.csv — one row per post, dated, editable on your phone in Google Sheets.
Brand rulesmarketing/brand-prompt.md. Never invent results, ratings or testimonials.

How to read a post block. Each post has one core idea and up to four platform versions. The platform versions are different writing, not the same caption pasted four times.

The daily mix. 3 teaching, 2 memes, 2 trust posts, 2 offer posts, 1 story, 1 hot take. Memes sit near 20% of output.

Scheduling a month ahead. Everything below is dated. Open the sheet, sort by date, and schedule the whole month in one sitting. The app is for the days when something needs writing on the spot.

Post 01 · The three-part price reply

Type: Teach · Why it works: Relief. It gives them the exact fix for a moment they have already lived through today.

Hook (0-3s)

Someone asked how much. You sent the number. They vanished.

On-screen beats

  • The problem is not the price
  • 1 · Say the price
  • 2 · Say what it includes (one line)

Voiceover script

Someone asked how much, you sent the number, and the chat went quiet. The problem is not the price. It is what happened after it. Try three parts. Say the price. Say what it includes in one line. Then ask one question that moves things forward. That question is what turns a number into a conversation. I keep 36 of these scripts in one file. Five thousand naira, details on my page.

Post 05 · Set up WhatsApp Business properly in four minutes

Type: How-to · Why it works: Competence. Something they can finish before their next customer arrives.

TikTok · 15:00 · Screen recording or hand-held demo, 30s

Hook (0-3s)

Your WhatsApp profile is doing nothing for you right now.

On-screen beats

  • 1 · Put a real photo, not a logo
  • 2 · Name it what you do
  • 3 · Add your services to the catalogue
  • 4 · Turn on greeting and away messages
  • 5 · Save your best 5 replies as quick replies

Voiceover script

Four minutes. Open WhatsApp Business, not plain WhatsApp. First, put a real photo there, people buy from faces, not logos. Second, name it what you do, not your initials. Third, add your services to the catalogue so people can tap instead of typing. Fourth, turn on greeting and away messages, and make them sound human. Five, save the five replies you send every day as quick replies. That is the setup. The 7-day checklist does the rest.

Post 01 · How to sound credible before you have results to show

Hook (0-3s)

  • Show the constraint, not the boast
  • Say what you will not do
  • That reads as honest

Voiceover script

Most small businesses think trust comes from testimonials. It does not. It comes from being specific enough to check. I have built pages with no client results to show. What I showed instead was the thinking. Here are four things you can put on a page tomorrow, with nothing to invent. One: the constraint. Say who it is not for. Two: the decision behind your work. Three: the honest limitation. Four: the process, step by step. Pick one. Put it on the page. You do not need a famous name to be believed, you need to be checkable.

Post 01 · Service one: what digital marketing strategy actually is

Voiceover script

What is a marketing strategy, really? Here is the honest version. It is a set of decisions. Who you are for. What you say to them. Where you say it. What happens after they respond. That is it. Post 03 · When to raise your price, and how to say it

Voiceover script

Three signs you should raise your price. One, you are turning work away. Two, you dread writing the quote. Three, your last three jobs took longer than they should. Any one of those and your price is wrong. When you do raise it, do not double it. Raise it by twenty percent on new work only, keep the old price for old clients, and say nothing about it. Post 11 · The one question to ask before you lower your price

Type: Direct response · Why it works: Direct response. A practical question the audience can ask in their next conversation, which drives comments and saves.

TikTok · 21:30 · Kinetic type with voiceover, 20s

Hook (0-3s)

Before you drop your price, ask this one question.

On-screen beats

  • "What were you hoping to pay?"
  • If they say a number,

price is not the problem

  • If they say nothing,

they have no comparison

  • Now you know what to fix

Voiceover script

Before you drop your price, ask this one question: what were you hoping to pay? If they give you a number, the price is not the problem, and you can either meet it or walk. If they say nothing, they have no comparison, and the problem is that they do not yet understand what they are getting. Those are two completely different problems and they need two completely different answers. One question tells you which one you have.

Post 10 · A proposal is not a price list

Type: Hot take · Why it works: Hot take. It reframes a boring document into a persuasion tool, and it is a position people disagree with.

TikTok · 20:45 · Talking head, 25s

Hook (0-3s)

A proposal is not a price list. I will explain what that means.

On-screen beats

  • A price list says: this costs X
  • A proposal says: here is

what I understand, and here is what happens next

  • Then it says: this costs X
  • Same price, different outcome

Voiceover script

A proposal is not a price list. A price list says this costs X. A proposal says here is what I understand about your problem, here is what I am going to do about it, here is what I need from you, and this is what it costs. Same price, completely different outcome. The customer is not comparing your price to your cost. They are comparing your document to the alternative of doing nothing, which is free, and which is why the document has to do some work.

Caption

A proposal is not a price list. A price list says: this costs X. A proposal says: here is what I understand, here is what happens next, and this is what it costs. Same price. Different outcome.

Post 05 · How to reply when they want it cheaper

Type: Teach · Why it works: Teach. The most common objection in Nigerian small business, handled properly rather than defensively.

TikTok · 15:00 · Kinetic type with voiceover, 30s

Hook (0-3s)

"It is too expensive" is not a price objection. It is a question about fit.

On-screen beats

  • Do not discount first
  • Ask: what is the budget?
  • Then offer something smaller
  • Not the same thing, cheaper

Voiceover script

It is too expensive is not a price objection, it is a question about fit. And there are two ways to answer it. The bad way is to discount straight away, because now you have taught them to ask again next time. The good way is: what is the budget, and then offer something smaller. Not the same thing at less money. Something smaller. A different scope, a different service, the same quality. The person who wanted the jacket gets the repair, and they remember you did not argue with them.

Caption

"It is too expensive" is not a price objection. It is a question about fit. Ask: what is the budget? Then offer something smaller. Not the same thing at less money. Something smaller. A different scope, the same quality.

Post 08 · How to keep your voice when you use AI

Type: Teach · Why it works: Teach. It is the practical, money-saving skill, and it is what the pack's best section teaches.

TikTok · 19:00 · Kinetic type with voiceover, 30s

Hook (0-3s)

How to keep your voice when you use AI. Four rules, and the first one does most of the work.

On-screen beats

  • 1 · Write three sentences

in your own words first

  • 2 · Give it your words

to keep

  • 3 · Ask for ten versions,

pick one

  • 4 · Rewrite one line

by hand, every time

Voiceover script

How to keep your voice when you use AI. Four rules, and the first one does most of the work. One, write three sentences about the thing in your own words first, before you prompt anything. Now you have something to compare against. Two, give it your words and tell it to keep them. Three, ask for ten versions and pick one, instead of editing the first. Post 01 · How to say what you do in one breath

Type: Teach · Why it works: Teach. It is the most reusable sentence in the whole month, and it applies to a page, a caption and a conversation.

TikTok · 07:00 · Kinetic type with voiceover, 30s

Hook (0-3s)

If you cannot say what you do in one breath, nobody else will say it for you.

On-screen beats

  • I help [who] to [do what]
  • That is the sentence
  • Everything else is

the explanation

  • And the explanation comes second

Voiceover script

If you cannot say what you do in one breath, nobody else will say it for you. Here is the sentence: I help this person to do this thing. That is it. Everything else is the explanation, and the explanation comes second. People who write one breath first and then explain it sound clear. People who explain first sound like they are apologising for existing.

Post 09 · How to price a bundle without confusing people

Type: Teach · Why it works: Teach. Bundles are where small businesses get tangled, and the rule is simple and useful.

TikTok · 20:00 · Kinetic type with voiceover, 30s

Hook (0-3s)

Three options on a page is a choice. Five is a maths problem. Here is the fix.

On-screen beats

  • Pick one to be the obvious one
  • Make it the cheapest to start,

not the cheapest

  • Mark the other two honestly
  • And say who each is for

Voiceover script

Three options on a page is a choice. Five is a maths problem, and the customer is doing the maths instead of you. The fix is this. Pick one to be the obvious one. Make it the cheapest to start, not the cheapest overall, because that is the one you want them in. Mark the other two honestly, with who each is for. And never let the middle option be a padded version of the cheap one, because that is the one that makes people think you are being clever.

Caption

Three options is a choice. Five is a maths problem, and now the customer is doing the maths instead of you. Pick one to be the obvious one. Make it the cheapest to start, not the cheapest overall. Mark the other two honestly. Never let the middle option be a padded version of the cheap one.

We changed one thing about deliveries. We started sending the arrival time as a message before they asked for it. Not a review request, not a discount, just the time. Likes, reach, follower growth. A month of those is a month of feeling busy. Ask the third question instead, and it changes what you make next month. A message is not a metric. It is a person who wanted something, and it tells you which subject to make more of. The weekly version of this review, fifteen minutes on a Friday, is in the Chat-to-Customer Playbook, ₦5,000. Post 07 · Consistency is not a virtue

Type: Hot take · Why it works: Hot take. It challenges the gospel of posting every day with a better, more nuanced position.

TikTok · 18:00 · Talking head, 25s

Hook (0-3s)

Consistency is not a virtue. I will explain what is instead.

On-screen beats

  • Consistency means

posting when you have nothing to say

  • That teaches people

to ignore you

  • Being reliable is a virtue
  • Being predictable is not

Voiceover script

Consistency is not a virtue. Consistency means posting when you have nothing to say, and after a while people learn that some posts are filler, and they start skipping them. Being reliable is a virtue. Being predictable is not. Show up when you have something, say clearly when you do not, and do not post a daily reminder of the fact that you are alive.

Caption

Consistency is not a virtue. It means posting when you have nothing to say. And after a while people learn which posts are filler, and they start skipping them. Being reliable is a virtue. Being predictable is not.

Post 01 · The order of a proposal

Type: Teach · Why it works: Teach. It teaches a genuinely useful structure that most small businesses get wrong.

TikTok · 07:00 · Kinetic type with voiceover, 30s

Hook (0-3s)

The order of a proposal decides whether it gets read. Four parts, in this order.

On-screen beats

  • 1 · Their problem, in

their words

  • 2 · What you will do,

and what you will not

  • 3 · The price, and the

next step

  • 4 · The proof, last
  • Proof last. Always last

Voiceover script

The order of a proposal decides whether it gets read. Four parts, in this order. One, their problem, in their words, so they feel understood before they see your work. Two, what you will do, and what you will not do, because the second half is what makes it believable. Three, the price and the next step. Four, the proof, and proof goes last, always last, because proof before the price is just showing off.

Every chat that ends in a sale goes through five stages. Missing one is where you lose them.

  • 1 · Greeting,

because silence is rude

  • 2 · Understanding,

what do they actually want

  • 3 · Answer, price and options

Voiceover script

Every chat that ends in a sale goes through five stages. One, greeting, because silence is rude and rude loses the sale. Two, understanding, what do they actually want, because most people ask "how much" before saying what it is for. Three, answer, with the price and the options. Four, next step, one clear action. Five, after, when they go quiet. Most businesses do one and three. That is why most chats die.

Voiceover script

If the answer is no, you have bought a photograph, not a website, and photographs cannot be updated.

Post 05 · How to ask for a review without begging

Type: Teach · Why it works: Teach. A small, exacting piece of craft that the audience can use this week.

TikTok · 15:00 · Kinetic type with voiceover, 25s

Hook (0-3s)

How to ask for a review without begging. The trick is in the first sentence.

On-screen beats

  • Never start with

"would you mind leaving a review"

  • Start with the job
  • "Glad the screen was

sorted, and it was quick, right?"

  • And make it easy:

send the link

Voiceover script

How to ask for a review without begging. The trick is in the first sentence. Never start with would you mind leaving a review, because that is asking for a favour. Start with the job: glad the screen was sorted, and it was quick, right. And make it easy: send the link in the same message, so there is nothing to figure out. People review when it is easy, not when it is meaningful.

Post 01 · How to ask for a recommendation

Type: Teach · Why it works: Teach. It is the cheapest growth channel in Lagos and one almost nobody executes well.

TikTok · 07:00 · Kinetic type with voiceover, 30s

Hook (0-3s)

How to ask for a recommendation. The cheapest growth channel in Lagos, and nobody does it.

On-screen beats

  • Never: "can you refer

somebody to me?"

  • Instead: "who do you know

who might have this problem?"

  • Make it easy to say no
  • And give them the words

to say about you

Voiceover script

How to ask for a recommendation. The cheapest growth channel in Lagos, and nobody does it. Never: can you refer somebody to me. That is asking for a favour. Instead: who do you know who might have this problem. Make it easy to say no, because if somebody hesitates, they will not reply at all. And give them the words to say about you, because a referral with no words in it is just a name.

too busy to fix the price

  • So a discount is a

liquidation, not a promotion

to liquidate

Voiceover script

A discount in December is a confession. You just told everybody your price was wrong. If you can drop thirty percent in December, why not in August? Because you were too busy to fix the price. So a discount is a liquidation, not a promotion. And you do not need to liquidate. You need a reason to buy now that is still true in March, and there is one: the deadline you set, and the reason behind it.

That means a real deadline, with a real reason behind it: we are closing the December intake on the 15th, or this price covers work we can start before the holidays. A deadline with a reason is information. A discount with a countdown is pressure, and the smart customers can feel the difference, and they wait you out. The One-Offer Landing Page Kit, ₦5,000, has the copy templates for the offer, the objection block and the deadline sentence. Message PAGE on WhatsApp: 0905 069 0837.

How to publish this from your phone

One file. EASYWURLD_POST_COMMANDER.html is a single file, works with no internet, and saves your tick marks on the phone. Add it to your home screen and it behaves like an app.

Free scheduling, no new apps.

PlatformHow to scheduleCost
Instagram + FacebookMeta Business Suite, timezone Africa/LagosFree
TikTokSchedule option inside the app for business accountsFree
LinkedInThe schedule button in the post composerFree

Set the whole month in one sitting. Every post above is dated, so the first Sunday of the month you can schedule all thirty days at once. After that it is 20 minutes a week. Leave the two slots a week that need a real human reply open, and do not schedule a post you have not read out loud once.

Where to schedule from. content_calendar.csv is the same plan as a Google Sheet. Sort by date, and every row carries its time, its format and the full copy, so you never have to remember which post goes where.

Storage. Keep images and videos in Google Drive, not on the phone. Open them from Drive when you need them. Text is cheap, video is not.

Reply first, post second. A reply to a real customer beats one more post. If a slot arrives and a customer is waiting, answer the customer and let the post wait.
